verdict.rationale: EBANX's own docs say merchants can "issue full or partial refunds" (ebanx-docs-5), so the core refund capability is first-party documented. The evidence never says which channels deliver it: no refund API endpoint and no dashboard refund flow are cited. The unified API claim (ebanx-docs-18) and the dashboard's existence for payment links (ebanx-docs-13) do not show that refunds specifically run through either. Missing for 10: an explicit refund API endpoint or parameters, a documented dashboard refund workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
